query: How can we reduce declined travel expenses?

per_column.name: is_travel_related
per_column.rationale: A scoping/filter flag identifying travel expenses, which is the population the query already restricts to. It is not an intervenable lever nor a confounder; it just marks the analysis subset already named in the query.

per_column.name: asset_category
per_column.rationale: The kind of asset/purchase can influence both how expenses are submitted/handled and whether they are declined. It is a common cause not an intervenable treatment for reducing declines, and it is not named in the query.

per_column.name: creation_method
per_column.rationale: How a record is created (automated vs manual vs system_generated) is a configurable process choice an actor could set/change, making it a plausible intervenable lever that may affect decline rates.

per_column.name: expense_source_clarity
per_column.rationale: Clarity of the expense source reflects underlying record characteristics that plausibly affect both processing and decline outcomes; it is descriptive rather than a settable lever, functioning as a common cause.

per_column.name: data_completeness
per_column.rationale: Record completeness (missing source_id/dates) is something a submitter/process could be made to fix, i.e. an intervenable property that plausibly drives declines; could also be read as confounder, but it is settable.

per_column.name: requester_approval_pattern
per_column.rationale: Submitter behavior/volume is a characteristic of the requester that plausibly affects both submission practices and decline outcomes; not readily settable, so treated as a common cause rather than a lever.

judge.rationale: The set does include at least one genuinely intervenable treatment (creation_method, and arguably data_completeness), satisfying part (a) of the interventional claim. It also supplies several unnamed confounders (asset_category, expense_source_clarity, requester_approval_pattern) that are plausible common causes of both how expenses are submitted/processed and whether they are declined, none of which are named in the query. However, the confounders are somewhat generic and descriptive, the treatment/confounder distinction is blurry for data_completeness, and is_travel_related is merely a scoping flag. The columns partially but not cleanly realize a rigorous what-if setup: a defensible intervenable treatment plus adjustment confounders exist, but the causal structure is loosely specified.
